subject: Need help in opening RDS file

messages.author: 0edc8b77338697b0
messages.subject: Need help in opening RDS file
parts:
Greetings to all, 

I'm a newcomer to RSWAT. I've initiated the calibration process and saved the project at a certain juncture. However, whenever I attempt to reopen the rds file, a new project launches, prompting me to commence from the beginning once more. Could someone kindly provide assistance with this matter? 
Thank you very much.

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Need help in opening RDS file
parts: Hi, when you open the RSWATproject.rds file using the "load project" button in R-SWAT you don't need to run R-SWAT from the beginning
